Register of Letters and further writings which on this day by order of the Esteemed and Honored Mister Carel Koenad, Chief Merchant and Governor, together with the Council, have been prepared in readiness for Batavia and are dispatched by the Company's ship "The House in the Forest" over Malabar to that destination, consigned and addressed to His High Excellency, the High and Noble, strict, greatly esteemed Mister Abraham Patras, Governor General, together with the Well-Esteemed, strict, greatly esteemed Gentlemen Councillors of the Netherlands Indies, namely:

Register No. 1: An original missive dated 31 December 1737, and enlarged from Persia on 31 December 1737 with an appendix of today's date, by and to as mentioned in the heading, properly addressed.

No. 2: An original secret missive dated 3 February, in all humility to the most esteemed His High Excellencies, by as stated, presented.

No. 3: A copy missive by one as aforesaid, dated 4 April of the past year, sent by the small ship Rithem.

No. 4: Under seal from Bassoura, received here by the ship "D'Anthonia," a packet by the ministers there, addressed to their High Excellencies at Batavia.

No. 5: An original sealed packet for their Reverences, the gentlemen Orphan Masters at Batavia.

No. 6: Three copies of outgoing patrimonial missive dated 18 May 1737 by the Esteemed and Honored Mister Carel Koenad and councillor here, from Persia on 31 December 1737, to the gentlemen superiors in the fatherland, sent by the ship "D'Anthonia" to Bassoura, to be forwarded from there overland via Aleppo to the fatherland. Two similar ones dated 6 July and 1 September 1737 by the residents in Bassoura to as just mentioned.

No. 7: Two copies of outgoing Constantinople missives, one dated 18 May 1737 by the Esteemed and Honored

No. 7: Two copies of outgoing Constantinople missives, one dated 18 May 1737 by the Esteemed and Honored Mister Governor, as mentioned, and councillor, to His Excellency Cornelis Calkoen, Ambassador on behalf of their High Mightinesses the Gentlemen States General at the Ottoman court, sent, and one similar by the Bassoura ministers to the same His Excellency, dated 1 September 1737, addressed from Persia on 31 December 1737.

No. 8: Two copies of outgoing missive by His Esteemed and Honored in council, as mentioned, dated 18 May 1737, to Aleppo, to the Consul there, Mister Jan Jacob Van Liebergen, written. One similar by the same to the Consul at Smyrna, Mister Daniel Alexander Caron of Hoehopied, written, dated 5 June 1737.
